analysis.title: Gaming and Leisure Properties Inc. (GLPI): 3Q26 First Take: Development spending progressing, new JV in focus
key_insights: GLPI reported 3Q26 AFFOPS of $1.04, above the GS estimate of $1.02 and the FactSet estimate of $1.03.
GLPI raised the low end of its FY2026 AFFOPS guidance to $4.11-$4.12 from $4.10-$4.12. The $4.115 midpoint is in line with the GS and consensus estimate of $4.12.

GS expects GLPI to perform in line with REITs on Friday because the guidance increase is close to consensus. GS notes macro headlines, moves in the 10-year UST, and details of potential future deals could move the shares either way.
GLPI invested $187mn in developments in 3Q26 (Bally's Chicago and Live! Virginia).
Guidance includes $265mn of remaining 2026 development funding in 4Q26, bringing the 2026 total to $800mn, from $750mn to $800mn previously.

GLPI's remaining funding upside across its commitments is about $1.2bn. Management says it can fund the rest of the pipeline with debt, with net financial leverage staying at the low end of the targeted 5.0x to 5.5x net debt to adjusted EBITDA range.

GS will look for earnings call detail on Chicago completion timing in 2027, development funding by project, new tribal and acquisition opportunities, potential new gaming jurisdictions, and funding mix (equity, debt, asset sales).

GS will also look for rent coverage by tenant, operator performance by market (Las Vegas vs. regional), the impact of iGaming, prediction markets and sports gambling, tenant diversification including CZR, and competitive supply dynamics.
GS keeps a Neutral rating with a 12-month price target of $46, based on a Q5-Q8 AFFO target multiple of 10.7x, against a $39.49 price (16.5% upside).

market_movers.rationale: Neutral rating and $46 price target maintained after 3Q26 AFFOPS of $1.04 beat the GS estimate of $1.02. Guidance midpoint is in line with consensus.

earnings_insights: GLPI 3Q26 AFFOPS reported $1.04 vs GS estimate $1.02 and FactSet consensus estimate $1.03.
GLPI FY2026 AFFOPS guidance raised at the low end to $4.11-$4.12 from $4.10-$4.12. The midpoint of $4.115 compares with GS and consensus estimates of $4.12.
GS FFOPS estimates: $4.12 for 12/26E, $4.29 for 12/27E, $4.49 for 12/28E. GS quarterly FFOPS estimates: $1.02 for 9/26E (reported AFFOPS was $1.04), $1.04 for 12/26E, $1.06 for 3/27E.
GLPI 2026 development funding guidance is $800mn, raised from $750mn-$800mn, including $265mn in 4Q26.

GLPI funded $186.6mn across its investment commitments in 3Q26 and $882.0mn cumulatively. Of the $2,067.3mn total commitments, $1,185.3mn remains unfunded. Total commitments carry a blended 8.85% cap rate.
risk_factors: Higher or lower volume of accretive acquisitions or developments than expected.
Higher or lower CPI or variable rent adjustment, and lower or higher interest rates and interest expense.
Weaker tenant performance, tenant bankruptcies, credit concerns or move outs.
Macro headlines and moves in the 10-year UST could move the shares.
